reviews.text: Dr. Johnson is one amazing veterinarian.  She is so knowledgeable, caring  and resourceful when it comes to the care of my dogs.  The staff is equally wonderful with the care they take and the follow up for each of my pets.  I trust Dr. Johnson implicitly with my pups.  I wish my own GP was as amazing for me as Dr. Johnson is for my pups.  Love the Infurmary!!

My husband and I visited The Infirmary yesterday with our two high-maintenance dachshunds, and we couldn’t have been happier with the experience! The staff were incredibly attentive and compassionate, even bringing out a ball to help our dogs feel more comfortable and relieve their stress. They were also very informative and took the time to address all of our dogs’ needs.

The Infirmary is officially our permanent veterinary clinic! We wholeheartedly recommend them to anyone looking for a caring, patient, and understanding veterinary team, especially if your dogs experience anxiety or stress during vet visits.

Dr. Johnson and staff were able to help my little Scottie. She had been in pain for 3 months and her regular vet gave meds but they just didn't work for her. I saw Dr. Johnson on a news clip and I knew I had to take her there. My little Skye is doing well now. She still needs to get fully recovered but Dr. Johnson  as far as I am concerned she is the best as well as her staff.

I brought my cat here after he had a bad reaction to a medication prescribed by another vet who dismissed our concerns and insisted we continued the medication while offering no alternatives.

From our first visit, Dr. Johnson and the team were incredibly patient and open to hearing our concerns. They took the time to explain multiple treatment options, including the pros and cons of each, while also providing their professional recommendations.

During our most recent visit for my cat's dental cleaning, the team was once again so patient and reassuring. I felt completely confident and comfortable leaving my cat in their care. I remember having so many questions and despite how busy Dr. Johnson was that day, she so very patiently answered every question and took the time to discuss everything with us.

One thing that really stuck with me is how Dr. Johnson usually fully sits on the floor to interact with my cat, and I can tell that really help to reduce the stress my cat feels. The team is also always so kind and gentle with my cat, even when he once had a little pee accident in his carrier on the way there.

You can genuinely feel their love and care for animals here, I'm so happy to have found a wonderful team. Highly recommend!

I came to the infurmary becauce our frenchie needed to get a new vet in the area. Im so glad this clinic has opened and in my area. Dr. Johnson and her entire staff were wonderful and compassionate people. I felt like my little nugget was in good hands. The rooms are all very clean and the entire presentation was impressive. The prices were very reasonable and I found it easy to speak with the doctor and her staff. Dr. Johnson even got down on the floor with us during the exam so it wouldnt be as stressful on our little girl was has some ptsd now of clinics post following a double denucleation surgeries within the past 2 years. Dr. Johnson and her staff have all been lovely. I hope this place stays around for a long long time.

Dr. Johnson and the entire staff at The InFURmary are amazing. Everyone is kind, knowledgeable, and you can tell they genuinely care about every animal that comes through the door. They also do an incredible job taking care of our search and rescue canines, which means a lot to all of us who rely on these dogs to stay healthy and ready to work. Dr. Johnson is thorough, easy to talk to, and always takes the time to explain everything. We’re very fortunate to have her and the entire InFURmary team looking after our dogs.

Dr Johnson has been our family vet for many years now.  She currently treats my two seniors, 13 (doxie mix) and 17 (doxie)

She is so amazing with the animals - they are her patients and she treats them as such with a kind and gentle bedside manner

My pups who have not taken to other vets in the past, all wag their tail and seem happy to see her which makes trips to the vet more pleasant for everyone

I attribute the long lives my pups have had to her knowledgeable care and treatments

My opinion - she is the best vet in San Diego which is why I have followed her and drive 30 minutes to see her.  Work every minute and more. There are plenty of vets between my home and her office, but none that I trust like I do Dr Johnson

I took my 5 year old Australian Shepherd to InFURmary do to a none weight bearing hind leg.  Dr. Johnson did a very thorough physical and recommended x rays to back her findings.  I opted for the full body x rays and was very pleased I did so as Dr. Johnson was able to review each part of her body and recommend treatment for her hind joint and things to watch out for per the xrays.  InFURmary has very sophisticated non surgical options I have only found in the Equine World.  I am so pleased that I can now use them on my beloved Fay and get her back to working, playing and agility.
Thank you Thomas for the 5 star review. We appreciate it!! We hope Tony Gwynn's limping feels better with the meds that were provided.
I took my cat here who usually hates the vet and is scared but the staff here were so kind and took care of my cat great! I will definitely be coming back here.

I had an excellent experience with Dr. Johnson. Our dog has been experiencing mobility issues and Dr. Johnson spent a great deal of time with her, being extremely thorough in trying to determine the cause of her symptoms.

During our appointment she explained everything and also sent a detailed follow-up report afterward. She was very helpful in how to move forward and her dedication showed how much she genuinely cares about the well-being of all of her patients.

I highly recommend Dr. Johnson to anyone looking for a veterinarian who is thorough and truly cares.

My senior dog collapsed and we were unable to take him to our normal vet. Luckily the inFURmary gave us a same day appointment. I was nervous because we had been with the same vet since my dog was a puppy, he is 9yrs old now. All my fears faded away as our appointment began. The doctors and nurses took such amazing care of my senior dog. I love how attentive they were with him. They kept us informed on everything they were doing with him in his treatment and explained the science behind each action. It’s clear there is a deep love for what they do here. I especially love how upfront they are about the cost of everything. They provided us options of care without making us feel forced to pick the most expensive option. Instead, they offered us choices with cost and an explanation of WHY they wanted to follow that form of treatment, but ultimately gave us space to discuss what we felt was necessary and affordable. We are switching all care to this office thanks to their customer service, evidence-based care, affordability, and fantastic communication. Highly recommend.

Amazing experience with this vet. They were able to accommodate a last-minute emergency appointment, which meant so much to us, our french bulldog was very uncomfortable keeping one of his eye opened. The staff was kind, professional, and made us feel reassured during a stressful time. Highly recommend! Fair prices and very nice environment

So grateful we found this place! It’s been such a relief to feel like you can actually talk to your Vet and they LISTEN. Without making you feel rushed. Dr. Johnson’s knowledge and willingness to help and provide guidance is something I didn’t have at my last office. You can tell she loves animals and the whole office has been just as wonderful. They work with my schedule, always so friendly and caring, and response time is amazing! Thank you inFurmary

We’ve brought our two Labrador retrievers here three times over the past month, and every visit has confirmed we found the right clinic. The staff are wonderful with our girls, patient, gentle, and clearly comfortable with big, energetic dogs.
What stands out most is how collaborative the doctor is. Instead of just handing us a treatment plan, she walked through the options with us and we made decisions together, which makes a huge difference when it comes to our pets’ care. On top of that, pricing has been very reasonable, no surprise costs, no upselling.
If you’re looking for a vet clinic that treats your dogs like family and treats you like a partner in their care, I highly recommend this one.

I am definitely impressed by what was a wonderful veterinary experience. Everything was clearly and thoroughly explained and very reasonably priced. There was no pressure to pay for services I did not want or feel that I needed. Everyone was friendly and professional.
Dr. Johnson is the absolute best. She is thorough and compassionate. She truly cares for each animal as if it's her own. Truly one of a kind.
Hi Maria, Thank you so much for the 5 star review. We appreciate it!
Max’s introductory visit was most pleasant and informative. Max was at ease throughout. I am very happy that I chose inFURmary as Max’s vet.

The inFURmary is a wonderful veterinary hospital! I was in search of a new veterinarian for my dog and was fortunate to find them. They are not a corporate run office  but are a private practice and Dr. Johnson and her staff are very friendly, professional and informative. It was very refreshing to find a veterinarian that provided the highest quality of care! I feel confident my dog will be very well cared for throughout his lifetime.

We found Dr. Johnson a couple of months ago after I tried three different vets. She’s the only one that was willing to try low dose protocol (for meds) for my girl that was diagnosed with an Addison disease.
Una loves her new vet. Recently we brought our other dog that is developing kidney issues. Dr. Johnson is patient and knowledgeable.
Very good vet and nice people

Excellent Excellent Pet care. I have an older dog that has arthritis and Dr. Johnson gave me all the information I needed to make the best decision on how to alleviate his pain. One of the most beautiful pet hospitals you could ever walk into.

It took me far too long to write this review, but I'm finally getting to it, so here it goes.

Back in February 2025, my dog, Morpheus, was misdiagnosed with a sprained ankle at another pet hospital in Point Loma. After a week with no improvement, I brought him back to that hospital, to see why he wasn't improving. That's when they discovered the original diagnosis was incorrect and told me he had osteosarcoma (bone cancer).

Morpheus was a 9-year-old, 130-pound Mastiff. Because of his size and age, amputation wasn't a realistic option. The veterinarian who initially misdiagnosed him was new to the practice, but that didn't change the reality I was facing...

I went home with my best friend in pain, preparing for the heartbreaking decision I knew was coming.

After processing everything, I called back and asked if there was another veterinarian I could speak with about our options. That's when I met Dr. Johnson.

She adjusted Morpheus's pain medications and recommended a treatment he would receive every three weeks to help manage his pain and slow the progression of the cancer. Thanks to her knowledge and compassion, I got three more precious months with my boy.

What makes this even more remarkable is that it was Dr. Johnson's last week at the hospital in Point Loma before leaving to open her own practice. Even though she was moving on, she made sure Morpheus would continue receiving the best possible care. She left detailed instructions for the other veterinarians on his treatment plan and how to properly administer his medication.

As Morpheus's condition worsened, I wanted him to be seen by Dr. Johnson one last time to find out if there was anything else we could do. Unfortunately, her new practice hadn't opened yet. Morpheus passed away three weeks before she officially opened her doors.

Even though he hadn't been her patient for months - and her clinic wasn't even open yet - Dr. Johnson and her staff continued texting me to check on him and see how he was doing right up until his last day.

That, to me, is what an exceptional veterinarian looks like.

She went above and beyond in every possible way, and I will always be grateful. Without her, I truly believe I wouldn't have had those extra three months with Morpheus. Given how advanced his cancer was, that amount of time was something I never expected.

I recommend Dr. Johnson and this practice to anyone who asks. I have a new puppy now, and even though I live in Temecula, I will gladly make the drive to Poway because finding a veterinarian you trust - someone who genuinely cares about your pet and your family - is worth every mile.

Thank you, Dr. Johnson, for giving me more time with my best friend. Those three months are something I will cherish forever.

I took my large dog in for Synovatin injections into her arthritic knees. The staff and doctor were very professional and a pleasure to work with. Dr. Jackson is extremely knowledgeable and everyone seems to really enjoy each other. My dog recovered really well and is doing great!

I am very grateful for the care pur pup received. We needed an emergency procedure done. They were able to take her in the same day.
The vet also understood that she is a sporting pup and training to compete amd may need extra recovery.
It has now been 3 months, and our pup is healthy and back to training.
Thank you for caring for our furred family member.
The care they gave our pup was absolutely fantastic
Hi Elesha, Thank you for the 5 star review! We hope you and Mochi are doing well <3

We brought our 12 year old cat in to get treated for lymphoma and found that Dr. Johnson is an exceptional vet who truly cares about the work she's doing and the animals she cares for. She took her time and answered all our questions with great care, we did not feel rushed at all and she gave us her undivided attention. Her treatment plan prioritized the comfort of our little cat and made us feel far more at ease which we really appreciated. She was so gentle with our cat, she even sat on the floor to make him more comfortable for his physical exam. She really knows her stuff and is a top caliber professional I cannot recommend highly enough!

My new vet!  They were open on a Saturday, got my little dog (new rescue) in quickly, and I was so impressed. Dr. Johnson and her staff are so kind, very attentive, and super knowledgeable!  This is an impressive facility, and I highly recommend!!

I called on Thursday afternoon and was able to get a vet visit the next morning. The staff was very kind, communicative, and understanding. I own a husky who can be very loud and get separation anxiety during vet visits. I addressed this with them over the phone and in person and they were very accommodating. My dog (who can get very woo woo and reactive at times) has never been so zen in a vet visit before. He definetly hates the vet in general, but they made the experience be amazing and I was able to stay in the room with him during his exam. (He was in for a heartworm test). I really really appreciate the vet office, the vet, and their team for all their kindness and knowledge which included recommendations for some dryness in his paws I’ve recently noted.

We came here From out of town for end of life care for our beloved 12-year-old dog who had end stage cancer. When our primary vet told us it was time to say our goodbyes, we wanted to find a place that was not just Clinical but had a warm environment and a specialty team that would be a better fit for us to say goodbye. We called a few places and knew this was the team after we spoke with them. The team was so incredibly kind from the first person we met at the front desk, to the nurse as well as the doctor. Everyone made the experience, humane, compassionate, warm, and reassuring. It is never easy to help our best friend crossover to the rainbow bridge, but having a team like the infurmary Where you are in a homie setting with clinically knowledgeable staff who are also compassionate and warm is the best thing we can do for our furry friends. Thank you to the team for making one of our toughest days a little bit lighter with your kindness and skill, we are so thankful Sergio was such good hands!
So professional and knowledgeable and they obviously love their patients! I always learn so much from Dr Johnson.

6 stars out of 5 if I could :)
Our first visit with Dr Johnson for our Mochi was great. The facility was nice, clean, and nicely stocked with treats for our dogs. The staff were all SO kind and looked happy to be there and genuinely enjoy taking care of animals. The vet tech and Dr Johnson took their time with our timid Shiba. She gets really anxious at the vet, and this was probably one of the least traumatic visits for her. Dr Johnson examined her slowly on the floor, talking to her, introducing herself before jumping straight into prodding and poking. I felt like she listened to our concerns and gave sound, reasonable advice for our elderly girl. The prices were very reasonable to me. Especially after visiting a recent vet we didn’t like at Poway for 1 thing and being charged $200 more than we paid today despite addressing multiple complaints today. They were also quite transparent with their prices online.

I actually liked our vet visit today rather than leaving stressed and dissatisfied. I am planning to switch our other dog’s care over to here too once she’s due for her annual visit. We have moved around a lot in the 13 years I’ve had my dog and this is in my top 2. I’m so glad I found this new vet near me!
Dr. Johnson and her team are amazing! They took tremendous care of our kitten during our past vet visits. I will definitely recommend this clinic!
I had an amazing experience at the InFURmary.  Everyone here is very nice and professional and I loved Dr. Johnson!

Dr. Johnson is, without question, one of the most thorough veterinarians I've ever worked with. From the moment we met, she made me feel like every detail mattered. She spent real time checking my dog out for both the issues i mentioned and anything else that may have been hidden.

What impressed me most was her approach to treatment recommendations. She thoughtfully explained multiple care options, clearly outlining the pros and cons of each route without ever making me feel pressured into additional services or procedures. It was refreshing to work with someone who prioritizes informed decision-making as opposed to overly commercialized vets pushing for every possible test.

I have a very dog-reactive Great Dane, and veterinary visits can be challenging. Dr. Johnson immediately took her needs into account and arranged for us to use a separate entrance so she wouldn't have to interact with other dogs. I typically have a very hard time at the vet, running quickly through lobbies to avoid a scene. Having a side entrance made a huge difference in reducing me and my dog’s stress.

It was clear she genuinely cared about my dog’s well-being and wanted the experience to be as low-stress as possible.

To top it all off, she finished our visit with a Great Dane-sized pup cup, which absolutely made her day.

If you're looking for a veterinarian who is knowledgeable, thorough, kind, and truly committed to individualized care, I cannot recommend Dr. Johnson highly enough.

We brought our two Pomeranians to see Dr Johnson after having a bad experience at our last vet. The waiting room was clean and spacious, and had a beverage fridge with sodas and sparkling water for humans and a pup cup station for the dogs.

Lara was our vet tech and she was very warm and knowledgeable. Dr Johnson was also personable and spent a lot of time with us and our pups and even sat on the floor with them to do their exam. Our dogs stayed with us the entire time which was importantly to us because the older one gets so anxious.

We booked an appointment because our last vet was sending notifications that they were due an immunization, but at the inFURmary they said it wasn’t necessary yet if we weren’t boarding our dogs.

Dr Johnson provided us with a joint supplement that our picky dogs actually loved, and a prescription for our older dog to fill at a pharmacy of our choice. She also has many options for pain relief and support for dogs which will be helpful as our dogs age.

We never felt rushed or pressured to do extra diagnostic tests on the spot.  We left with a quote for x-rays for our other dog’s joints, but really appreciated that we were given time to think about it. Our last vet would push diagnostics and blood tests at every visit and we were made to feel guilty if we said no. They also would take our dogs away to do the exams, tests, and shots, so we could not stay with them.

Overall we were impressed with our first experience at The inFURmary and feel a lot more comfortable taking our dogs to the vet now!

Thank you for your feedback. We take all reviews seriously and always strive to provide excellent care and service. At this time, we are unable to locate your name as a client  associated with this review. If you believe this review was intended for our hospital, please contact us directly so we can learn more about your experience and address any concerns personally.
Dr. Johnson is fantastic. She fit me in last minute and was friendly and thorough. The hospital is beautiful too.
Dr. Johnson and her staff are amazing!
Best Vet I've ever been too. The whole staff is amazing!
Hi! Thank you for the 5 star review. We appreciate it

I love this place and everyone who works there. The staff is so helpful, my cat had an accident in her carrier due to nerves and the sweet lady at the front desk helped me take care of it. We’re always immediately taken back to an exam room, which really calms my girl down, it has treats and a cat tree that goes a long way in soothing her. The vet, and vet techs, are all so kind and my cat obviously is very comfortable with them. It’s easy to make an appointment online and they have great availability. I’ll choose this place any time! (:
Prompt, caring service is what Dr. Johnson and her staff deliver at every turn. Highly recommend with their great skills, boundless knowledge and experience along with an amazing facility.
Very welcoming and knowledgeable staff. I came to the Infurmary for a pain assessment for my dog. Dr. Johnson explained what options are available. I feel like we are in good hands.

Very accommodating, kind & helpful, great communication. We wanted to get Synovetin injection treatments for our dog, Juno for her severe elbow osteoarthritis while we were vacationing from Canada but we were on fairly tight time line. Synovetin is only available at specialized vet clinics like the InFURmary, requires advance prep & radioactive handling precautions but they made it work for us. Kept costs to a minimum by making use of X-rays & info provided by our regular vets. Took extra care while Juno was under sedation to look for other issues that could be impacting her movement & provided shock wave treatments to her shoulders to help improve her mobility.
It takes time for the Synovetin treatment to repair the damage in the joints but Juno is doing great and moving much more comfortably now. Dr. Jacqueline, Shirley and staff were absolutely great!! 🐾

Great 1st appointment at the Infurmary- the office is relaxing and beautiful , snacks for pets and humans ! Staff is welcoming and Vet care is excellent . Dr.Johnson has all the latest treatments available . I highly recommend this practice .
Got my dog in on an emergency appointment. Very friendly and helpful.
Very pleased with the service I received, Dr. Johnson was very kind and caring..
Hi Lisa, Thank you for the 5 star review! We love Mazi and Lulu <3

I had to bring my cat in for an emergency xray and exam, and the care team at inFURmary were all amazing! From the front desk staff to the vet tech and vet, the care was kind, clear, and thorough. In a stressful situation, my cat and I felt very supported and cared for. Great care and great team!
Hi Leslie, thank you for bringing Pete in for a pain consult and for the 5 star review! We appreciate it.
Dr. Johnson is an excellent veterinarian! She is thorough and Gives her patience the time and attention they deserve. The staff in office are very kind and accommodating. Highly recommend this place!

My daughter and I followed Dr J from her previous clinic to her own business, best decision!
Both of our pups have been cared for by this amazing staff
Highly recommend the InFURmary!!

Super thorough, compassionate, allowing some procedures to be done not "in the back" based on the dog in front of her.
We've been to lots and lots of vets and specialists over the years with different dogs for a variety of issues. The vast majority have been fantastic. My number 1 goal is to have the visit as least traumatic as possible and Dr Johnson did just that. Not that it was super fun for the patient but she made it the least unpleasant as it could be.
I really loved that she paid attention to subtle pain responses before his stoic instincts kicked in.

The staff were very welcoming and personable to me and my dog as soon as we entered the office. The facility is very clean, modern, and functional. Dr. Johnson is very knowledgeable, patient and kind. She did a thorough pain evaluation and was able to treat my dog the same day. He has made tremendous improvement within a week. Highly recommend the inFURmary!

I called in for an emergency for my baby boy. His face swelled up overnight and his nose split from the swelling and was bleeding. He was in so much pain. They were able to fit me in right away and were so empathic and kind. I was a mess and panicking. They were patient and saw to him right away. They pricing wasn’t a shock it was extremely cost effective (cheaper than my own vets). I can’t thank the team enough. They treated us with respect, understanding and kindness. The bonus is they are 5 mins from where we live. Will definitely return. Thank you so much!
Thank you for the 5 star review! We appreciate it

RETRO INTERIOR-DESIGN CHIC PLUS A FIVE STAR VET

My service labrador has had a super complicated medical history, and had been through hell and back, which means I have to. He is going through an intensive treatment, and I found Dr. Johnson through AI (both ChatGPT + Gemini)

I called and was given a same day appointment—unheard of, and it is true: DR. JOHNSON IS A DIFFERENT KIND OF VET.

Driving into a strip mall near a gas station, you think "oh no, we're entering vet clinic hell—chemicals, dog pee, hair all over the place, "CAUTION" signs on the floor, mops, and the smell of your money leaving your wallet.

NO - I entered a mint and orange retro style clinic that had Wallpaper of dog's pooping that I would have found on Etsy, and ULTRA-clean vet clinic—like a crime scene clean up came with a museum restoration company and cleaned before each dog entered. I was then showed the fridge which had PUPCUPS, and also human snacks and drinks. Okay so we're at a resort - getting the vibe.

The vet tech (Laura?) came out and got me and my labrador, and already knew about his case, offering a personalized greeting, and sympathizing with the history of a complex six year old lab.

I had sent what some would call a MANIC email that was about 12 pages long, and instead, I was told I was organized, and they loved that my email had an index. When I had checked my email, I saw response and thought they're going to say "too much, sorry we can't take it" like 10+ vets have, but no.

Dr. Johnson did the MOST thorough exam of any vet, specialist, etc. I've been to, and I wish she was also my doctor. She had come to conclusion I had come up with using AI based on lab results, and had studied in the two hours between my email and our arrival.

She was informative, HUMAN, compassionate, empathetic, smart, and extremely organized. She treated my dog like my dog, and not a number, a patient, or statistic. She wasn't pushy about services, and it felt like an authentically collaborative experience. She answered all 853 of my questions, and gave me reasoning behind decisions. We have a plan - an ongoing plan. Substantially different than the bandaids and BYE BYE's I've had at nearly all other clinics and hospitals.

In the past, I had to use my own work technology to secretly source my vets personal emails because their staff was so disorganized, but not here, Dr. Johnson OFFERED me her email. I told her "I wouldn't if I were you... honestly"...knowing myself, and she said "it's fine"... TBD.

THAT is not just caring, its investing in a patient and a process, across 6 states, and countless vets and specialists, Dr. Johnson, her clinic, and how they operate, IS rare both in human medicine and vet medicine.

Despite a 64 minute drive home, I felt safer, more at ease, and for the first time (maybe second) in a vet setting, I felt HEARD.

If you love your pet as much as I do (two tattoos, a wall dedicated to him in my house, and a world that revolves around him), THIS IS YOUR NEW VET CLINIC.

Actually, instead of vet clinic: Let's call it what it is—a FIVE STAR VETERINARY MEDICAL SPA.
Was my first time taking my cat to this vet and it definitely won't be the last.

My Frenchie recently started going to The inFURmary as her vet and we absolutely love it! Dr. Johnson and the rest of her staff are great! Dr. Johnson does an amazing job with making you feel really comfortable, is very thorough and informative, takes the time to answer questions, and is so sweet to my Joy! We’re so happy that we take Joy to The inFURmary and I definitely recommend it!

I brought my cat in on a Saturday and this is the best vet I’ve been to in San Diego. They listened, didn’t make me feel crazy, and were transparent about every test they wanted to run, why, and what it cost. I was there long enough to hear them with other patients and they definitely love them the way we do. I will be back and would definitely recommend to others!
I absolutely loved my experience. I will be using them moving forward. Dr.Johnson was incredible and I learned so much!

I transferred my 5 dogs to the InFURmary after my former vet clinic went corporate. The InFURmary and the owner, Dr. Johnson, and her staff, are like a throwback to decades ago when service and excellent bedside manner were priority one for clinics. They also offer injections for arthritis that has worked wonders on my Rottweiler that has severe elbow dysplasia. She is now running around as if she never has the condition.

Took my pup in for concerns of increased anxiety. When we walked in we were greeted by a beautiful lobby and very friendly receptionist! Everything has been completely thought out for the comfort of the pet and their human. They even had dog beds in the room. The treatment plan was clear and they did what was in best of my dog. Thank you for some amazing care!

Brought my nearly 16 year old shy/nervous cat Willis to this practice because I thought he would do better with a woman veterinarian. The clinic is very nice, clean and bright. Bea, at the front desk and RVT, Lara, were wonderful. Dr. Johnson was very nice as well. My only criticism is that I would have liked a bit more direct interaction with her. I would have especially appreciated a phone call from Dr. Johnson to discuss Willis’ blood and urine test results, rather than an email. I know I can contact the office with any questions, but it just would have been my preference to speak to Dr. Johnson about Willis’ test results. Thank you.
Hi EK S- Thank you for your 5 star review. We appreciate the support!
very friendly service, super trustworthy and overall good service!
Beautiful clean facility. Super friendly , knowledgeable staff. My dogs love them. Prices were extremely fair. I’m so happy I found the Infurmary.
Staff was really friendly and knowledgeable. Listened to what was said and took concerns seriously.

After a lifetime of owning pets, and visiting countless vets, our new Vizsla pup Bodie and I have found our "happy place." The team at the inFURmary is simply top notch, making us feel welcome and providing the expert, confident kind of care you want (and should insist on) for your 4-legged friend. Their clinic is very clean and bright, and there are lots of smiles to go around. You can tell immediately they love their work - I highly recommend!

Beautiful vet facility with beautiful people.
Dr . Johnson is phenomenal.

We've had such great experience's here. We've been here a couple times now with our dogs and our cat. And every time the staff is so welcoming and warm, they really listen to our concerns with our animals and they take such great care of them. Our cat is very feisty so when they did her exams, the staff handled her so well that she just melted into their arms and almost fell asleep. That really says a lot.
She also had to have eye surgery. Everything went smoothly and they explained everything very thoroughly/after care/pricing etc and answered all my questions. Pricing was extremely reasonable and the breakdown was easy to understand.

The rooms are extremely clean, organized and welcoming to pets ie cat trees in the cat specific rooms which is a detail we loved. And a little pup cup station for our dogs at the end of their apt! Just little things to cause less stress on the animals.

All in all this is our new vet. 10/10 experiences thus far

Our dog was injured while on a trip in San Diego.  They got us in promptly and we're so kind and did a great job.  The office is modern, clean, and there is even a dog bed in the exam room!   Dr Johnson and her tech explained everything thoroughly.  Pricing was also very good.  If I lived here this would be my vet!

We came here for a neuter and had such a good experience. They even offered to do it same day. The dr and vet tech were very caring and explained any questions i had. We felt very comfortable and the staff are super kind thank you for taking care of my pup!
Friendly and caring staff. My dogs hate going to the vet... this experience changed all of our minds!
The doctor and staff really seemed to care about my dog and his health. They also did not try pad the bill and sell me a bunch of extra stuff. I appreciated the caring and honest approach.

I had a wonderful experience with Dr. Johnson and her staff. They are so patient and loving with my senior dog. We went for a pain consultation as I thought we were hitting a wall with her arthritis management. Dr. Johnson gave me so many options, worked with my budget, and guided us through the process. I was so impressed with her expertise, and how she kept both my dog and I comfortable throughout the entire visit.
